mission: Close E10-F1: a ball-less practice swing committed FOREHAND at the 0.8 confidence ceiling because reference_is_event_peak_not_contact never gated commitment and nothing in classifyStroke required ball/paddle-contact evidence.

change.design: Contact-evidence gate (stroke-heuristic-5 / lite stroke-heuristic-3.1): when the reference is only the isolated event's motion peak (contactMs missing) AND the contact point is not a plausible paddle observation (contactPointSource !== 'paddle'), the side commitment is treated as degraded-trust: the SIDE_MARGIN_DEGRADED_BAND (0.5 shoulder-widths) abstention band applies (limiting factor side_margin_within_no_contact_evidence_abstention_band) and confidence is capped at DEGRADED_CONFIDENCE_CAP (0.6) with limiting factor no_contact_evidence_confidence_capped. Full abstention was NOT chosen: the lite red-team suite pins that a genuine swing with an event-peak reference and no paddle track (mobile reality) must still commit a side, and the practice-shadow fixture is kinematically identical to that genuine swing — no measurement in the input can separate them, so the defensible fix is capped confidence plus an explicit evidence-absence flag, never full confidence.
files: packages/swing-lab/test/strokeHeuristicAmbiguous.redteam.test.ts (F1 pin flipped per file protocol: pin deleted, fixture kept, assertion inverted; F5 pin updated to the measured capped behavior, root cause still open; umbrella pin now covers F2/F4/F5 with F1 removed)
change.thresholdProvenance: No new thresholds introduced; reuses existing SIDE_MARGIN_DEGRADED_BAND=0.5 and DEGRADED_CONFIDENCE_CAP=0.6 (both dev-anchored, documented in-file). The gate only extends the existing degraded-trust semantics to a new provenance condition; no contract was weakened.

e10F1Outcome.note: Label unchanged by necessity (fixture kinematics identical to a genuine no-paddle swing the test suite requires to commit); the 0.8-ceiling confidently-wrong commitment is closed. E10-F5 (wheelchair rim push, same input shape) is also capped 0.8 -> 0.6 as a side effect; its root cause (no symmetric-motion discriminator) remains open and its pin was updated to say so.
